intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create a complex photorealistic test photograph of one unmistakably adult woman, visually informed by the supplied appearance reference, performing a coral-health survey in a bioluminescent aquarium while keeping her unobscured face and complete hair arrangement readable for later visual-semantics evaluation.

Create a complex photorealistic scene of one unmistakably adult East Asian woman, visually informed by the supplied portrait: warm fair skin, an oval face, softly arched brows, almond-shaped dark eyes, a refined straight nose, and natural full lips. She conducts a coral-health survey in an after-hours bioluminescent aquarium research gallery, holding a handheld fluorescence scanner against a marked viewing pane while recording one tagged colony's reading on a waterproof slate. Cyan and emerald coral polyps glow beyond the glass, with spectral calibration tiles and specimen tags making the scientific task legible. Her face is unobscured, and her entire hair arrangement is clearly readable from roots through outer silhouette to all visible ends. Prioritize convincing adult facial likeness, complete hair readability, and materially realistic coral fluorescence, glass reflections, and survey equipment.
